about.description: Phoenix on the Bay is a waterfront condominium community located along Terry Cove in Orange Beach, Alabama. The property offers a distinctive bayfront setting with views of Terry Cove, Robinson Island, and Perdido Pass, while remaining just a short drive from public beach access. The property features fully furnished 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom vacation rentals with equipped kitchens and spacious private balconies overlooking the bay and pool areas. With an on-site marina, boat launch, and boat slips, Phoenix on the Bay is well-suited for guests who enjoy boating, fishing, and water-based recreation during their stay. Guests booking through Brett/Robinson receive professionally managed accommodations and local destination expertise.
about.elevator_pitch: Waterfront bayfront condo community in Orange Beach with marina, boat slips, and resort-style amenities perfect for boating and fishing enthusiasts.
